```ruby # app/models/article.rb class Article < ApplicationRecord include Ransack::Adapters::ActiveRecord::Quering def self.ransackable_scopes(auth_object = nil) [:search_by_title_and_body] end def self.search_by_title_and_body(query) if query.present? where("title ILIKE ? OR body ILIKE ?", "%#{query}%", "%#{query}%") else all end end end ``` ```ruby # app/controllers/articles_controller.rb class ArticlesController < ApplicationController def index @q = Article.ransack(params[:q]) @articles = @q.result(distinct: true) end end ``` ```erb <%= search_form_for @q, url: articles_path, builder: SimpleForm::FormBuilder do |f| %> <%= f.input :title_or_body_cont, label: 'Search by title or body' %> <%= f.button :submit %> <% end %>
    <% @articles.each do |article| %>
  • <%= article.title %> - <%= article.body %>
    • <% end %>
``` This setup uses Ransack's `ransackable_scopes` to define a custom search scope that performs a case-insensitive (`ILIKE`) partial match across the `title` and `body` fields of the `Article` model. The form in the view allows users to input a search query, which is then used to filter articles accordingly.
